title: Viva Insights: leaders can publish Power BI reports
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout, default, publishing controls and qualified licensing statements are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. One minor qualification is needed: Learn makes email delivery to security groups conditional, whereas the notice describes recipient notifications without that detail.
